etymologies.etymologyHTML: From engineer +‎ -ing.

definitions.definition: present participle and gerund of engineer
(uncountable) The application of mathematics and the physical sciences to the needs of humanity and the development of technology.

quote.citation: 2014 June 14, “It's a gas”, in The Economist, volume 411, number 8891:
quote.text: One of the hidden glories of Victorian engineering is proper drains. Isolating a city’s effluent and shipping it away in underground sewers has probably saved more lives than any medical procedure except vaccination.

definitions.definition: The area aboard a ship where the engine is located.
Actions controling the motion, shape, and/or substance of any physical object(s).
Designates office area of the professional engineering staff.
